meta.promptText: India mein acne wali skin ke liye 700 rupees ke andar konsa serum kharidun?

response.text:
Haan — **₹700 ke andar acne-prone skin ke liye meri first choice Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Serum** hogi. Current listings mein 30 ml roughly **₹494–₹549** ke aas-paas mil raha hai. [beminimalist.co](https://beminimalist.co/collections/serums-acne-acne-prone-skin/products/salicylic-acid-2?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### [Minimalist Salicylic Acid Face Serum]()
*₹549*

**Kyun?** 2% salicylic acid pores ke andar excess oil/dead skin ko target karta hai, isliye **active pimples, blackheads aur oily skin** mein useful hai. Brand ise combination/oily, acne-prone skin ke liye recommend karta hai. [beminimalist.co](https://beminimalist.co/collections/serums-acne-acne-prone-skin/products/salicylic-acid-2?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Agar alternatives chahiye:**
- **The Derma Co 2% Salicylic Acid Serum** — around ₹237–₹449, depending on seller/size. 
- **The Derma Co Sali-Cinamide** — around ₹313; salicylic acid + niacinamide combination. 
- **Minimalist Niacinamide** — agar main problem **acne ke baad ke marks + oiliness** hai rather than frequent active pimples. 

**Mera pick:** 👉 **Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid**, especially agar pimples/blackheads baar-baar hote hain.

Start **2–3 raat/week**, 2–3 drops, aur moisturizer use karo. Din mein **SPF 30–50 sunscreen** zaroor lagana.

Agar tum mujhe bata do **skin oily/dry/combination hai aur acne kis type ka hai (small bumps, whiteheads, painful pimples ya marks)**, toh main ₹700 ke andar **exact 1 serum + moisturizer + sunscreen routine** suggest kar dunga.
